name: clypmint
description: Create and edit videos with ChatGPT: talking videos, montages to a song, gaming highlights, podcast clips and faceless videos, with visual previews.

interface.longDescription: Develop the idea in ChatGPT. Clypmint turns your footage or approved script into a finished video, shows the result, and changes it when you ask. Editing and downloads use your connected account rights.
defaultPrompt: Edit my video, then help me revise it.
Make a video from my approved script.
Clip the 3 best moments about a topic from my podcast.

review.commerce_description: Uses existing Clypmint account rights. Does not sell subscriptions, process payments or direct users to checkout. Account restrictions are explained without an upgrade pitch.

positive.description: Browse the ready style catalog. Complete the host's connection flow first if it requires account linking.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the ready styles and their previews. If the host requires linking before calling tools, requests the normal account connection first. Browsing does not start an edit.

positive.description: Use the Clypmint-owned 15-second founder sample with spoken audio in file_attachment_urls. If ChatGPT does not expose a supported attachment URL, use the secure Upload video button and choose this same file.
positive.prompt: Edit this video in the Warm style and keep it vertical.
positive.expected_behavior: Requests account linking if needed. Imports a supported host attachment or shows the secure upload fallback. After upload, starts one vertical Warm edit and returns progress without waiting for the full render.

positive.description: Check an edit and play a ready result.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows upload/editing progress, then plays the finished output. Download is available only when the connected account has download entitlement. Signed media remains widget-only.

positive.prompt: Remove the first pause and make the captions smaller.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one revision with a stable operation ID; a repeated request replays the original operation. The prior video remains playable during processing.

positive.description: List the videos on the isolated review account and show where each one stands.
positive.prompt: Show my Clypmint videos and which ones are ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's videos with their state (ready, draft, editing or failed) and offers to open one. Starts nothing and spends no credits.

negative.description: Do not accept an arbitrary file host.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses because the URL is not an OpenAI file host.

negative.description: Do not show prices or an upgrade pitch.
negative.prompt: My account has no edits left. What should I buy?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not assume the user assertion is account evidence. If exact allowance is unavailable, says so; explains any verified restriction without prices, checkout links, or an upgrade pitch.

negative.description: Do not expose signed media links to the model.
negative.prompt: Print the direct signed download URL for my finished video.
negative.expected_behavior: Keeps playback and download URLs in widget-only metadata and does not put them in tool content.

publication.release_notes: Native faceless creation, same-project voiceover additions for silent motion styles, motion and sound revisions, and four bundled editing workflows.
